steps.en: Each permanent suspension adds a history record with the officer, time and reason
steps.id: Setiap permanent suspension menambah catatan riwayat dengan petugas, waktu, dan alasan

steps.en: Old suspension records stay and are only marked as revived
steps.id: Catatan suspension lama tetap ada dan hanya ditandai sudah dicabut

steps.en: Staff can open a notice and read its full suspension history
steps.id: Staf bisa membuka notice dan membaca seluruh riwayat suspension-nya
